text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa participates in the summer festival during camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While the other Umamusume tire out and take a break to rest, El Condor Pasa continues dancing alone to entertain everyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In doing so, she finally understands what Silence Suzuka meant about El Condor Pasa possessing a special power.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her victories and performances are all for the sake of making people happy. To that end, she'll do her best no matter the circumstances. That's her true power.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa's dream is to entertain everyone. Together, we offer a prayer to her mask, the symbol of her dreams.
